learn.hook: Germs are too tiny to see, but they can make us sick. Let's beat them with clean habits!
points: Hygiene means keeping our body and surroundings clean so we stay healthy.
Wash your hands with soap and water before eating and after using the toilet. Rub for about 20 seconds.
Brush your teeth twice a day — in the morning and before going to bed.
Bathe every day, wear clean clothes and keep your nails short and clean.
Cover your mouth and nose with a tissue or your elbow when you cough or sneeze.

example.q: Kavya played in the mud and now wants to eat a banana. Her hands look only a little dirty. What should she do first?
steps: Germs are too small to see, so hands can carry germs even if they look clean.
Germs on hands can go into the mouth with food.
So she should wash her hands with soap and water before eating.
example.answer: Wash her hands with soap and water before eating

learn.reallife: Hum 'Happy Birthday' twice while you rub your hands with soap. That is about 20 seconds!

games.title: Washing hands the right way
items: Rub palms, backs, fingers and nails

games.title: Clean habits
items: We should brush our teeth twice a day.
Brushing in the morning and at night keeps teeth healthy.
If hands look clean, they have no germs.
Germs are too tiny to see.
Long, dirty nails can carry germs.
Dirt and germs collect under long nails.
Sneezing into your elbow helps stop germs from spreading.
It keeps germs off your hands and away from others.
It is fine to share a toothbrush with a friend.
Sharing a toothbrush can spread germs.
We should wash our hands after using the toilet.
This removes germs that can make us sick.

quiz.q: When should you wash your hands with soap?
options: Before eating and after using the toilet
quiz.explain: Washing hands at these times stops germs from getting into our body.
quiz.mistake: Washes hands only when they look dirty

quiz.q: How many times a day should we brush our teeth?
quiz.explain: Brush twice a day: in the morning and before bed.
quiz.mistake: Thinks brushing once a day is enough

quiz.q: Why should we keep our nails short and clean?
options: Dirt and germs collect under long nails
quiz.explain: Germs under nails can go into our mouth with food.
quiz.mistake: Does not know nails can carry germs

quiz.q: What should you do when you sneeze?
options: Open your mouth wide towards others
Cover your nose and mouth with a tissue or your elbow
quiz.explain: Covering a sneeze stops germs from flying out and reaching others.
quiz.mistake: Does not know sneezes spread germs

quiz.q: What does hygiene mean?
options: Keeping ourselves and our surroundings clean
quiz.explain: Hygiene is the habit of keeping clean to stay healthy.
quiz.mistake: Does not know the word hygiene

quiz.q: Which of these is NOT a clean habit?
options: Eating food that has fallen on a dirty floor
quiz.explain: Food from a dirty floor can have germs. The others keep us clean.
quiz.mistake: Thinks food is fine if picked up quickly

quiz.q: For about how long should you rub your hands with soap?
quiz.explain: Rubbing for about 20 seconds — humming 'Happy Birthday' twice — helps remove germs.
quiz.mistake: Thinks a quick splash is enough

quiz.q: Why should we keep our homes and surroundings clean?
options: So the flies have a place to live
Dirt and stagnant water can breed flies and mosquitoes that spread illness
quiz.explain: Mosquitoes breed in standing water and flies sit on garbage. Both can spread illness.
quiz.mistake: Thinks only the body needs to be clean

teach.ask: Gappu wants to eat right after playing in the mud. He asks: why should I wash my hands first?
teach.praise: Chirp! Soap scares away the germs!
teach.nudge: What do we use with water to wash away germs?

learn.hook: Run, jump, stretch, then sleep tight! Your body needs both play and rest.
points: Exercise makes our muscles and bones strong and keeps the heart healthy.
Children should be active for at least an hour every day — running, cycling, dancing, skipping or playing kho-kho and kabaddi.
Yoga helps the body bend and stay calm. International Day of Yoga is on 21 June.
Children your age need about 9 to 12 hours of sleep every night.
Too much time on phones and TV can tire the eyes. Playing outdoors is better.

example.q: Sameer stays up very late watching cartoons and feels sleepy in class. What should he change?
steps: Sleep helps the body and brain rest and grow.
Children need about 9 to 12 hours of sleep.
He should switch off the TV earlier and go to bed on time.
example.answer: Turn off the TV early and go to bed on time to get enough sleep

learn.reallife: Play a game of kho-kho, langdi or hopscotch with your friends this evening!

items.text: International Day of Yoga is on 21 ___.
Children need about 9 to 12 hours of ___ every night.
Exercise makes our muscles and ___ strong.
Be active for at least an ___ every day.

quiz.q: Why is exercise good for us?
options: It makes our muscles, bones and heart strong
It makes us sleepy all day
quiz.explain: Exercise keeps the body strong, fit and healthy.
quiz.mistake: Does not know why exercise matters

quiz.q: About how many hours of sleep do children of your age need each night?
quiz.explain: Children aged 6 to 12 need about 9 to 12 hours of sleep each night.
quiz.mistake: Thinks children need as little sleep as possible

quiz.q: On which date is International Day of Yoga celebrated?
quiz.explain: International Day of Yoga is celebrated every year on 21 June.
quiz.mistake: Mixes it up with other special days

quiz.q: Which of these is a good exercise?
quiz.explain: Skipping makes the heart beat faster and the legs strong.
quiz.mistake: Confuses resting with exercise

quiz.q: How long should children be active every day?
quiz.explain: Children should play or exercise for at least an hour every day.
quiz.mistake: Thinks a little movement is enough

quiz.q: What can happen if you spend too long looking at a phone screen?
quiz.explain: Looking at screens for a long time can strain the eyes. Take breaks and play outside.
quiz.mistake: Does not know screens can tire the eyes

quiz.q: Which is a traditional Indian outdoor game?
options: Ice hockey on a frozen lake
quiz.explain: Kho-kho is a chasing game played across India.
quiz.mistake: Picks a sport needing snow or ice

quiz.q: Why do we need to rest after playing?
options: Rest is a waste of time
Rest helps the body get back its energy
quiz.explain: When we rest and sleep, our body recovers and grows.
quiz.mistake: Thinks rest is lazy

teach.ask: Gappu wants to play all day and all night. He asks: do I really need rest and sleep?
teach.praise: Tweet! I will play in the day and sleep well at night!
teach.nudge: How many hours should I sleep?

learn.hook: Is a plate of only chips a good lunch? Let's find out what a healthy plate looks like!
points: A balanced meal has the right mix of different foods that our body needs.
Energy-giving foods: rice, roti, millets and potatoes give us energy to work and play.
Body-building foods: dal, milk, paneer, eggs and fish help us grow strong.
Protective foods: fruits and vegetables help keep us healthy.
Drink plenty of clean water. Eat chips, sweets and cold drinks only once in a while.

example.q: Meera's lunch is only rice. What can she add to make it a balanced meal?
steps: Rice gives energy, but it does not have everything.
She needs body-building food like dal or curd.
She also needs protective food like a vegetable or a fruit.
example.answer: Add dal or curd and a vegetable or fruit

learn.reallife: Make your thali colourful: something white, something yellow, something green — that usually means a good mix!

quiz.q: What is a balanced meal?
options: A meal with the right mix of different kinds of food
A meal eaten while standing on one leg
quiz.explain: A balanced meal has energy-giving, body-building and protective foods, plus water.
quiz.mistake: Thinks one kind of food is enough

quiz.q: Which of these is a body-building food?
quiz.explain: Dal is rich in protein, which helps our body grow and repair itself.
quiz.mistake: Does not know which foods help us grow

quiz.q: Which of these is an energy-giving food?
quiz.explain: Roti, rice and potatoes give us energy to work and play.
quiz.mistake: Mixes up food groups

quiz.q: Why should we eat fruits and vegetables?
options: They help protect us and keep us healthy
quiz.explain: Fruits and vegetables are protective foods that help the body stay healthy.
quiz.mistake: Does not know why fruits and vegetables matter

quiz.q: Which lunch box is the most balanced?
options: Roti, dal, sabzi and a fruit
Only chips and a cold drink
quiz.explain: It has energy food (roti), body-building food (dal) and protective food (sabzi and fruit).
quiz.mistake: Picks a tasty but unbalanced meal

quiz.q: How often should we eat junk food like chips and cold drinks?
quiz.explain: Junk food has too much salt, sugar or oil. It is fine only now and then.
quiz.mistake: Thinks tasty food is always healthy

quiz.q: What is the best drink when you are thirsty?
quiz.explain: Clean water is the healthiest way to stop thirst.
quiz.mistake: Thinks sweet drinks are better than water

quiz.q: Raju eats 2 fruits every day. How many fruits does he eat in 5 days?
quiz.explain: 2 fruits each day for 5 days is 2 + 2 + 2 + 2 + 2 = 10 fruits.
quiz.mistake: Adds 2 and 5 instead of making 5 groups of 2

teach.ask: Gappu wants to eat only sweet berries all day. He asks: what is a balanced meal?
teach.praise: Chirp! A little of everything makes a healthy bird!
teach.nudge: What foods help me grow strong?
